method: Reviewed all 54 candidate responsibilities, procedures, outputs, hard gates, permission identities, mutation scopes, triggers, anti-triggers, holdouts, baselines, and provenance in four bounded batches.
Computed pairwise lexical overlap across positive triggers at a 0.22 Jaccard threshold; manually adjudicated Playwright versus Vitest and website assessment versus remediation.

Reviewed all local-exec, external-read, local-system-write, external-session-write, and remote-write candidates for exact host actions, non-secret evidence, cleanup, rollback, revocation, deletion, cancellation, and not-executed state.
Reviewed implementation, test, review, performance, LLM evaluation, browser, tool, and workflow boundaries for one-writer ownership and independent-review separation.

resolved_findings.finding: The first Phase 6 compiler imported design modules only through repository package paths and failed when invoked directly as required by the unified runner.
resolved_findings.resolution: Compiler and design modules support both package and local-script imports; direct py_compile and execution now succeed.

resolved_findings.finding: Project context storage initially described external synchronization although its Phase 2 identity permits only local-system writes with no external read or write.
resolved_findings.resolution: The candidate now permits local same-store reconciliation only and blocks cross-machine or external synchronization pending a separate authorized capability.

resolved_findings.finding: Four anti-routes used conceptual names that were not Phase 2 capability IDs.
resolved_findings.resolution: Routes now target pull-request-comment-response, change-packaging-and-versioning, remote-pull-request-change, and remote-git-push, all exact Phase 2 owners.

resolved_findings.finding: The Gate's permission allowlist expression relied on Python set-operator precedence and incorrectly reported every non-empty allowlist as outside Phase 6.
resolved_findings.resolution: The union is parenthesized before subtracting expected ownership; the Gate now checks the intended set difference.

resolved_findings.finding: Framework source material could imply that local-exec Playwright and Vitest capabilities write project test files.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both candidates emit candidate test artifacts and may run or diagnose only existing authorized tests; project installation or writes route to test-runtime-bootstrap or an authorized workspace implementation.

resolved_findings.finding: Local-system candidates initially lacked a uniform explicit action-contract section even though they require backups, rollback, and cleanup.
resolved_findings.resolution: All five local-system, two external-session, and two remote-provider candidates carry external_or_system_action=true and the generated action boundary section; no action was executed in Phase 6.

boundary_samples.boundary: Investigation reproduces and proves the causal chain without source edits; remediation consumes a confirmed cause; TDD is the behavior-change loop that preserves RED before production code and may serve an approved repair.
Implementation owns one frozen task and initial patch; self-check may correct deterministic in-scope defects after completion but never impersonates independent review or expands scope.
Scope freeze defines one change boundary and non-goals; plan execution controls step states, dependencies, checkpoints, evidence, and invalidation without doing specialist work.

Guard authoring writes repository candidate policy and fixtures; local setup modifies only approved untracked repository-local hook/config state after consent, classification, backup, and uninstall planning.
Local integration mutates only a clean isolated local branch with recoverable refs; fetch, push, PR update, remote merge, force, and deletion remain separate remote capabilities.

Portfolio strategy assigns risks to layers and budgets; case design derives concrete traceable cases and one output format; runtime bootstrap installs the already-selected framework and proves it with one real test.

Both emit candidate artifacts under local-exec, but Playwright owns browser/API/visual journey patterns while Vitest owns JavaScript module, timer, mock, snapshot, and configuration patterns; neither writes project files.

Black-box QA discovers findings through public surfaces; triage deduplicates and routes existing findings; neither inspects or repairs source, while remediation needs separate accepted findings and authorization.

Acquisition binds diff, refs, checks, and read-only provider metadata without findings; independent review consumes that bundle and issues concrete findings without comments, fixes, or provider writes.
Compliance maps implementation to frozen requirements and design; code health assesses broader maintainability evidence; independent code review assesses a specific diff's correctness and security.

Frontend performance owns component and interaction latency under a frozen journey; Web diagnostics owns page navigation, waterfall, caching, assets, and Core Web Vitals; both diagnose only and require repeated distributions.

Assessment uses bounded local and read-only external evidence to issue findings; remediation consumes only accepted findings, changes authorized source, and requires separate reassessment without deployment.

Evaluator engineering implements and calibrates versioned evaluator definitions locally; quality evaluation runs governed checks over supplied outputs; an external judge remains blocked without separate transfer and provider authority.
Experiment execution performs one reviewed per-action provider run with frozen versions and budget; results analysis never submits runs and cannot change preregistered metrics after seeing results.

Authentication setup stores authorized local auth state but grants no data authority; session configuration creates ephemeral invocation state; acquisition requires separate origin, field, purpose, retention, and deletion authority and stays read-only.
Provisioning mints one scoped expiring pairing under per-action authorization; verification is local/read-only, cannot mint, renew, restart, widen, or treat connectivity as page-data authority.
Memory setup creates a project-isolated local runtime with no broad ingestion; context store performs per-record local operations only and blocks external or cross-machine synchronization.
Regression control runs matched checks and attributes deltas; completion gate runs no commands and verifies current target-bound command and artifact evidence against every required criterion.

release_claim: none; all 54 candidates remain evaluating, all evaluation plans remain not-run-phase-9, and all external or local-system candidate actions remain not-executed-phase-6
